feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 May 2026 11:07am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 04 May 2026 at 11:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, building a ridge across the Irish Sea.


##Wind##

Northwest 2 to 4, but variable 3 or less in places, becoming northwest 3 to 5 in all waters overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 3 to 5, veering northeast tomorrow afternoon, further veering east or southeast 4 or 5 occasionally 6 tomorrow evening, then decreasing 3 or 4 Wednesday morning.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate later for a time.


##Weather##

Occasional light/patchy rain tomorrow evening and overnight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.
